text:
mira: Heads-up on onboarding Orfeo15b (int4) to dedicated pool. Under load we're seeing allocation failures at the tail when max_new_tokens >= 280 and batch concurrency >7.

noah: Is it localized to a single node or across many? Any slotstats or frag numbers?

mira: Repro'd on canary across 3 nodes. slotstats snapshot: free_slots=4, active_slots=53, frag_ratio=0.46 after a few heavy long-gen sessions.

tess: Two hypotheses: 1) kv_prefetch bulk-reserves and leaves unusable holes when evicting; 2) warmstart reserve not sized for large max_new. Quick mitigations: disable `kv_prefetch`, set `warmstart_reserve_mb` to 350, enable `slot_compactor` short-window. Also cap `batch_limit` to 5 for the canary.

owen: Also propose a defensive runtime change: when a single alloc > 256MB is requested, try an "evict-before-alloc" pass to free cold slots proactively instead of waiting for GC. Metricize how often that path is used.

mira: sample failure log from canary node-2:
```
[2024-08-12T11:03:12Z] req=rid-1300 model=orfeo15b int4 seq_len=512 max_new=512
error: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
kv_cache reserved=1.95GB active=52 free=3 frag=0.46
GC reclaimed 32MB -> insufficient
```

noah: frag 0.46 is pretty bad. Proposed canary route config (pasted as YAML for readability):
```
route: orfeo-15b-int4-memcanary
defaults:
  max_new_tokens: 128
  batch_limit: 5
  kv_prefetch: false
  slot_compactor: aggressive (10m)
  warmstart_reserve_mb: 350
  slo_fallback: orfeo15b-int8-fallback
```

tess: +1. For rollout safety, gate default max_new_tokens change behind the eval harness: if generation-quality drop > 2% on our 4k prompt bench, rollback. Also set OOM guard: if OOM_rate > 0.5% over 5m, reroute to fallback model.

mira: starting canary deploy, then running 10m at 2x load and will run eval (4k prompts) against canary outputs.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for route `orfeo-15b-int4-memcanary` by mira at 2024-08-12T11:10:02Z :rocket:

noah: When you run the test, grab `nvidia-smi` dumps and `slotstats` every minute. If compactor drops frag < 0.2 and OOMs are zero, we can consider making kv_prefetch=false permanent for Orfeo.

mira: 5m into test: no OOMs, p95 latency +5% vs baseline. slotstats show frag_ratio -> 0.18 after compaction cycle.

owen: Looks promising. After eval, if NLG metrics are within threshold, promote to staged rollout with gradual traffic (10% -> 50%).

tess: Filing a quick issue to prototype `evict-before-alloc` with metric hooks. If that works we can avoid aggressive compaction in steady-state.

mira: Eval finished: BLEU/ROUGE-ish proxies and RL-scorer show <0.8% change vs baseline on 4k prompts. Passing our 2% guard.

deploy-bot: Canary passed smoke + eval checks at 2024-08-12T11:40:47Z.

noah: Next: ramp to 20% for 30m, monitor OOM_rate and tail latency. If any regressions, rollback to fallback.

mira: Will monitor. Thanks all! :heart:

tess: Nice work. Follow-up: add dashboards for preemptive-evict hit-rate and per-request alloc sizes so we can tune warmstart reserve dynamically.

mira: Filed dashboard + follow-up RFC link will be posted soon.

deploy-bot: Staged rollout to 20% started at 2024-08-12T12:05:03Z.
